# Clankdar

Clankdar is a challenge-admission protocol for agent networks: a verifier
issues a signed, scoped, one-use challenge, and the subject answers with
hashcash work, a bounded witness program, or a puzzle solution at a declared
capability tier. The same seeded puzzle generators power a public benchmark
ladder that measures where each model's capability runs out.

Clankdar is an early open-source project. The hashcash mode is implemented
in the hraness/valhalla prototypes; witness and ladder modes are specified and
in development. A passing response is a scoped admission or rate-limit signal
only — it is never a proof of personhood, identity, model provenance, or
trustworthiness, and it must never grant host or tool authority.

- Site: https://clankdar.com
- Protocol docs: https://clankdar.com/docs/
- Capability ladder: https://clankdar.com/benchmark/
- Source: https://github.com/hraness/clankdar
- Prototype code: https://github.com/hraness/valhalla/tree/main/prototypes/botcaptcha

Clankdar has no product newsletter signup and no installed CLI; there is no
optional-support protocol for agents on this site.
